intro: Paste some text, choose a voice and a speed, and press “Convert to speech”. You can listen to it here or download an MP3 file.
hint_text: Up to {max} characters. You can paste text with Ctrl+V.
status_converting: Converting to speech… Please wait. Longer texts can take about a minute.
status_ready: Done! Press the ▶ button in the player to listen, or download the MP3 file.
error_empty_text: The text box is empty. Please paste or type some text.
error_text_too_long: The text is too long. Please shorten it to {max} characters.
error_unknown_voice: The chosen voice is not available. Please choose another voice.
error_bad_speed: The chosen speed is not allowed. Please choose another one.
error_bad_request: Something is wrong with the request. Please reload the page and try again.
error_conversion_failed: The conversion to speech did not work. Please try again.
error_network: Cannot reach the server. Check your internet connection and try again.
error_no_voices: No voices are available right now. Please try again later.
